title: Perspectival subjects emerge as coherent regions of the field

statements.text: Meta-stable attractors in equilibrium with the field form localized regions, vortices in the ocean of cosmic consciousness, that shield an inner domain from the environment. Their boundaries tether them to a perspective, their long-range coherence gives unity, the coupling of field modes gives structured experience, and the plurality of such systems gives the subject-object character of experience.

sources.quote: which can also be thought of as vortices in the ocean of cosmic consciousness
we believe that these factors substantiate a minimal sense of perspectival subjectivity
